hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Verity guards this session. Before you finish, a check has to pass after your last code edit. A test, build, lint, or type-check command counts, run so its own exit status is the result: a pipe into `tail`, `|| true`, or a trailing `; echo` hides it. Keys go in a git-ignored env file, and tests are removed or skipped only when the user asks.
